messages:
Harper: Pushed a compact iteration of the Roles matrix + Invite header. Key goals: reduce visual clutter, make SSO enforcement wording explicit, and ensure Audit filters are easy to find. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/newframe (frame: roles-compact-alt). Diego: Nice! Two immediate thoughts: 1) When labels collapse, make sure the primary action (Invite) remains obvious. 2) Bulk CSV import must not be hidden from people who use it weekly. Maybe a persistent 'Import' micro-CTA that appears when org has >50 members. Mina: Accessibility note: collapsed labels + icon-only buttons require aria-label and visible focus rings. Also modals should focus first input (role select) and announce open with aria-live or role=dialog. Saw keyboard trap issues in previous PRs. Asha: Re: SSO copy: current label 'Require SSO' confused a customer. Suggest: `Enforce SSO sign-in for all members` and the helper text: `Disables password login. Configure IdP: Security → SSO.` Less ambiguous. Also add the small "Learn more" link in helper text. Victor: Audit log discovery: +1 to a sticky filter row above the table. Bonus: make the time filter default to 'Last 30 days' and expose an obvious 'Clear filters' action. Also prefer ISO date format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm` in the table for consistency. Harper: Implementation plan I'm putting on the ticket: - Responsive rules: full labels <= 900px, icon+label 900–1400px, icon-only >1400px with tooltip. - When icon-only, tooltips must show keyboard hints if assigned (e.g., "Invite (i)"). - Add Undo and "View rollback steps" link to the SSO toggle toast. - Keep persistent Import chip when org has CSV history. Diego: Copy sweep: replace "Grant role" => "Assign role" across UI and docs. Less formal and easier for new admins. Mina: I'll add the ARIA snippets to the PR template. Quick example to include: ```
...
``` Also checklist: focus order, aria-labels, contrast >= 4.5:1 for small icons, keyboard-only CSV import flow. Asha: Microcopy tweak: under the SSO toggle include: "Admins manage SSO in Security → SSO" so users know where to go. And on the confirmation toast: "SSO enforced — Undo" with a link to rollback doc. Victor: Keyboard nav idea: add `g r` -> Roles, `g a` -> Audit, and `i` -> open Invite modal. Low lift and boosts power-user speed. Flagging as follow-up. ops-bot: NOTE: Prototype updated -> roles-compact-alt-v1. Accessibility annotations added (focus order, role=dialog on modals, contrast checks). Harper: Great feedback — I'll update the figma and the ticket with these action items and post an updated prototype link by EOD. Ping me if you want to pair on the a11y checklist. :raised_hands:
